verdicts.reason: A: the headphones are cropped at the left edge, and the teal circle is cut off from the product and floats behind the right-hand stats column. The stats are reordered, and their labels are microscopic. The legal disclaimer sits beside the tagline at the same weight and wraps raggedly. Still, the headline, logo and CTA read as one clear block. B is far worse: the six stats are scattered around the canvas as tiny fragments (250 g crammed at the top edge, 6 mics floating top right). The legal text and the tagline are squeezed into narrow one-word-per-line columns. The CTA is a small pill lost at the bottom, and there is no grouping or grid at all.
